purpose: Claim-scoped primary-source snapshots for the October 2026 Digital Research Engine Kaizen. The previous dated register remains historical; dispositions for its six due records are recorded here.

sources.title: PRISMA 2020 statement resource page
sources.scope: The current PRISMA 2020 core statement and associated checklists and flow diagrams; not every extension.
sources.uncertainty: The resource page does not establish that every PRISMA extension is applicable or current for a specific review type.

sources.title: PRISMA-Children and Adolescents (PRISMA-C) 2026 extension
sources.scope: The extension's stated population scope and 2026 publication citation; it does not replace PRISMA 2020 generally.
sources.uncertainty: Use only for systematic reviews within the extension's stated paediatric intervention scope.

sources.title: GRADE Living Map
sources.scope: Official GRADE source repository and page-level currency labels; not the substantive content of every chapter.
sources.uncertainty: The map's JavaScript application did not expose an article-by-article result table to this text fetch; verify the relevant chapter in the source repository for each use.

sources.title: Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions, current version page
sources.scope: Version and publisher-listed update date for the intervention handbook only.
sources.uncertainty: Other Cochrane handbooks are separate; this row does not verify their versions.

sources.title: Intelligence Community Directive 203, Analytic Standards, including technical amendment
sources.publisher: Office of the Director of National Intelligence
sources.scope: Directive and technical amendment for Intelligence Community analytic products; not a general legal duty outside its stated applicability.
sources.uncertainty: The primary PDF states the 2015 directive and 2022 technical amendment; applicability remains bounded to the directive's scope.

sources.title: Intelligence Community Directive 206, Sourcing Requirements for Disseminated Analytic Products, technical amendment
sources.publisher: Office of the Director of National Intelligence
sources.scope: Officially indexed technical-amendment date and stated reference to ICS 206-01; full amended sourcing requirements were not text-extracted in this check.
sources.uncertainty: The PDF was discoverable as an official ODNI document but the browser text fetch returned no body. The amendment date and summary were visible in the official indexed result; detailed conformance is NOT_ASSESSED.

sources.title: RFC 9309, Robots Exclusion Protocol, RFC Editor information page
sources.scope: RFC identifier, title, Proposed Standard status and publication context; check errata separately before relying on a precise implementation detail.
sources.uncertainty: The information page directs readers to current errata; this cycle did not resolve every erratum or test a crawler implementation.

sources.title: TOP Guidelines
sources.scope: TOP 2025 component categories and implementation levels as described on the official page.
sources.uncertainty: TOP is described by its publisher as an evolving, community-maintained framework; recheck before compliance claims.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.scope: Provider-published release dates and descriptions; not comparative quality evidence.
sources.uncertainty: Release statements do not establish this account's access or task-level model superiority.

sources.title: OpenAI API models catalogue
sources.scope: Provider-published model IDs and descriptions as of access date.
sources.uncertainty: Catalogue presence is not proof of account entitlement or which model executed this session.

sources.title: GPT-6 Luna model page
sources.scope: Model ID and provider-documented model/API behaviour used by the Codex policy reference.
sources.uncertainty: The page does not establish local runtime entitlement, comparative task quality, latency or observed cost.

sources.title: OpenAI plugin submission error reference
sources.scope: ZIP submission archive entry-count limit only; not a source-checkout size requirement.
sources.uncertainty: A repository-tree count is a preflight proxy; a built archive may add or remove entries.

claims.text: PRISMA 2020 remains the core general reporting guideline presented on the official PRISMA resource page; applicable extensions must be selected by scope.
PRISMA-C 2026 is a paediatric intervention systematic-review extension to PRISMA 2020.
claims.limitation: Use only within the extension's population and intervention scope.

claims.text: The official GRADE Living Map distinguishes official current sources, related papers, and an archive of superseded or outdated material; use source-level status rather than a blanket Handbook currency claim.
claims.limitation: Relevant chapter text needs direct inspection for each task.

claims.text: The Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions current page lists version 6.5 (2024) and publisher-listed update date 22 August 2024.
The official ICD 203 PDF contains the 2015 directive and a technical amendment signed 21 January 2022.
claims.limitation: IC scope and applicability remain context-bound.

claims.text: The official ODNI result identifies a technical amendment to ICD 206 dated 18 December 2025 and states that ICD 206 requires sourcing under ICS 206-01.
claims.limitation: Full amendment text was not available to inspect in this check.

claims.text: RFC 9309 is listed by the RFC Editor as a Proposed Standard published in September 2022.
claims.limitation: Errata and implementation conformance require separate checking.

claims.text: The official TOP page says TOP 2025 contains seven Research Practices, two Verification Practices, four Verification Study types, and three levels for Research Practices.
OpenAI's official changelog records GPT-6.1 Terra as released on 26 October 2026; this release notice is not comparative task-quality evidence.
The provider catalogue snapshot includes GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6.1 Terra, and GPT-6 Luna.
claims.limitation: Does not prove local account entitlement or session model.

claims.text: The official GPT-6 Luna page is the primary provider source for the pinned model ID; the authorised Luna/high policy remains unchanged, while comparative quality, latency, cost and active-session availability remain NOT_ASSESSED.
claims.limitation: The model-policy review is not a claim of measured superiority.

claims.text: The OpenAI plugin submission error reference states that an archive must not contain more than 5,000 entries.
claims.limitation: This repository's full-checkout/package-oriented gate is a conservative preflight proxy, not a built-ZIP inspection.

dispositions.reason: The research engine does not select Astra; current model inventory is captured by the provider catalogue claim.
The current provider catalogue lists GPT-6.1 Sol; no engine policy or implementation claim relies on the former GPT-6 Sol record.
No task-level API cost estimate or API-price claim is used in this engine cycle; price comparison remains NOT_ASSESSED.
It supports downstream plugin-authoring documentation outside this repository; no Claude manifest edit is selected. Local plugin installation evidence is recorded separately.

limitations: Source metadata checks do not prove semantic support; the listed support states are researcher dispositions based on the specific source scopes above.
